title: Civic competence in the structure of future border guard officers' readiness for professional activity: the role of combat and veteran experience in its development
text_snippet: Civic competence in the structure of future border guard officers' readiness for professional activity: the role of combat and veteran experience in its development Background . Under current conditions, the development of civic competence among future officers in higher military educational institutions has become increasingly important as a key component of their readiness for professional activity. Officers serving in the security and defence sector are expected to embody civic values, national identity, legal awareness, patriotism, and responsibility for defending the state. In this context, particular attention should be paid to exploring the potential of combat and veteran experience as factors contributing to the development of civic competence among future border guard officers within the educational process. Methods . To achieve the research objective, theoretical methods were employed to analyse scholarly literature, legal and regulatory documents, and international experience in fostering civic competence among military personnel. Content analysis was used to examine Ukrainian legislative and strategic documents. The comparative pedagogical method was applied to generalise the experience of NATO member states. title: Psychological support for private security organizations: conceptualizing a new field of applied psychology
text_snippet: Psychological support for private security organizations: conceptualizing a new field of applied psychology Background. The global growth of the private security organizations (PSOs) market and Ukraine's legislative initiative to legalize private military companies are generating demand for specialized psychological expertise that currently lacks a systematic conceptual foundation. The study aims to conceptualize psychological support for private security organizations as an independent field of applied psychology and to define its structural and functional architecture, methodological toolkit, and specialist competency requirements. Methods. Given the theoretical nature of the study, the research employed hypothetico-deductive and phenomenological analyses of the subject field, a definitional and typological examination of the PSOs phenomenon, a comparative analysis of international experience (the United States, the United Kingdom, and Israel), and systematic conceptualization and modelling based on a synthesis of scholarly literature and regulatory documents. Results. text_snippet: A conceptual model of a psychological and pedagogical approach to the effective acquisition of short-term professional development course materials within the framework of professional support for psychologists of the Armed Forces of Ukraine Background. This study is motivated by the need to improve the professional development system for psychologists of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, enhance the effectiveness of professional training, and introduce innovative psychological and pedagogical approaches into professional development programs under conditions of limited training time, high intensity of the educational process, and heterogeneous levels of participants' prior knowledge and professional experience. Accordingly, the aim of this study is to substantiate a conceptual model of a psychological and pedagogical approach to ensuring the effective acquisition of educational content during short-term professional development courses as part of the professional support system for psychologists of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. title: Treaty-based architecture of the pan-European collective security system: a structural aspect
text_snippet: Treaty-based architecture of the pan-European collective security system: a structural aspect Background. Current transformations in the pan-European security environment, driven by growing military and political tensions as well as systemic crises, necessitate a comprehensive reassessment of how the existing treaty-based architecture of the pan-European collective security system operates. This study aims to develop a comprehensive understanding of the security architecture's structure, its constituent elements as well as operating principles, thereby enabling an assessment of its effectiveness, relevance, and efficiency under current security challenges. A decisive factor in the transformation of the pan-European security environment has been the large-scale invasion of Ukraine by the Russian Federation, which has significantly affected the configuration of regional security, exacerbating instability and intensifying contradictions between the main actors. Methods. The study employs comparative and analytical methods, together with systemic and historical approaches. Results. title: The impact of visual support on the development of listening skills in cadets of non-linguistic specialties at higher military educational institutions
text_snippet: The impact of visual support on the development of listening skills in cadets of non-linguistic specialties at higher military educational institutions Background. The article examines the impact of visual support on the development of listening skills in cadets of non-linguistic specialties at higher military educational institutions. The relevance of the study is determined by the need to improve cadets' comprehension of foreign-language audio materials, especially when their opportunities to use a foreign language outside the academic environment are limited. Methods. An experimental study was conducted with two groups of cadets who had the same level of foreign language proficiency. The first group completed listening tasks using audio materials with video support, while the second group worked only with audio materials. The results were assessed through a listening comprehension test, detail-recall tasks, and self-assessment questionnaires. Results. The cadets who worked with audio-video materials demonstrated better results in understanding the content and recalling details. On average, they gave 15% more correct answers and recalled 20% more additional details compared with the cadets who worked only with audio. title: Philosophical and psychological determinants of trust and constructive diplomatic interaction
text_snippet: Philosophical and psychological determinants of trust and constructive diplomatic interaction Background . In the context of transforming international relations, military and political tension, and the digitalization of diplomatic communication, the importance of trust and conflict-free diplomatic interaction has become increasingly evident. Diplomatic etiquette is considered not only as a system of protocol norms but also as a mechanism for expressing respect, recognizing the dignity and subjectivity of the other party, reducing communicative tension, and maintaining constructive dialogue. The purpose of the study is to substantiate the philosophical and psychological determinants of trust formation and conflict-free interaction in the system of diplomatic etiquette. Methods . title: Information security as a prerequisite for the strategic success of military operations:lessons from the Kursk operation
text_snippet: Information security as a prerequisite for the strategic success of military operations:lessons from the Kursk operation Background. The article examines the role of information security as a strategic instrument for planning and conducting military operations, using the Armed Forces of Ukraine's Kursk Operation (August–December 2024) as a case study. It highlights the importance of balancing society's right to information with information-security requirements in hybrid warfare. The aim is to analyse the mechanisms of information security and the implementation of communication strategies during the preparation and conduct of combat operations, using the Kursk Operation as an example. Methods. Three complementary methods were applied: normative-documentary analysis of five key legal acts and NATO standards; content analysis of media materials for August–December 2024 (in total, over 40 media reports and more than 15 analytical reports and expert publications were analyzed, drawn from official statements by the Armed Forces of Ukraine, Ukrainian and international media, and Russian propaganda sources); and a comparative method to juxtapose the actual course of combat operations with their media coverage across three segments of the information environment. text_snippet: The discursive power of the people's Republic of China: hidden strategies of global initiativesand challenges to Ukraine's foreign policy subjectivity Background. The transformation of the contemporary international relations architecture is accompanied by China's transition from a passive "rule-taker" to an ambitious global "rule-maker." In the context of Russia's aggression against Ukraine and the growing coordination between beijing and moscow, the critical analysis of the PRC's official discourse acquires direct practical significance for preserving Ukraine's foreign policy subjectivity and its Euro-Atlantic trajectory.The study aims to critically analyse the PRC's official discourse within its key global initiatives – the Belt and Road Initiative (一带一路), the Digital Silk Road (数字丝绸之路), and the Community of Shared Future for Mankind (人类命运共同体) – in order to identify the gap between their humanistic rhetoric and concealed strategic objectives, as well as to assess the challenges these initiatives pose to Ukraine's foreign policy autonomy. Methods. title: Recommendations for the use of topographic field aerial survey systems for updating large-scale topographic plans
text_snippet: Recommendations for the use of topographic field aerial survey systems for updating large-scale topographic plans Background. The article examines the current problem of rapid updating of topographic plans at a scale of 1 : 500 in conditions of an urgent need for rapid updating of geospatial data for the needs of engineering and cadastre. The use of traditional methods of ground surveying often turns out to be ineffective due to high labor intensity. The integration of modern unmanned systems into the workflow ensures the generation of detailed orthophoto maps with ultra-high resolution. The purpose of the study is to substantiate and develop practical recommendations for the use of modern topographic field aerial survey complexes for updating large-scale terrain plans. Methods. Modern topographic complexes DJI Inspire 2 and specialized P316 systems were used to conduct the study. The research methodology is based on a complex combination of advanced photogrammetric processing of image data in the Pix4Dmatic environment and subsequent vectorization of objects in ArcGIS Pro. title: A model for the systematic identification and sequential fulfillment of the hierarchical needs of persons with war-related disabilities and their family members
text_snippet: A model for the systematic identification and sequential fulfillment of the hierarchical needs of persons with war-related disabilities and their family members Background. The relevance of this study stems from the significant increase in the number of individuals with acquired disabilities resulting from the War of Independence in Ukraine and the need to ensure their dignified social and professional reintegration, as ignoring these needs may lead to social isolation, increased levels of depression, and the emergence of crisis situations among individuals with war-related disabilities and their family members. Methods. To achieve the study's objective and justify the proposed model, a comprehensive approach was used, based on the principles of the biopsychosocial model, as well as a systematic analysis of the needs of individuals with war-related disabilities and their family members. title: The use of artificial intelligence in English language teaching at higher education institutions: a theoretical analysis of the problem
text_snippet: The use of artificial intelligence in English language teaching at higher education institutions: a theoretical analysis of the problem Background. In recent years, both domestic and international educational research has shown growing interest in the use of artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools in foreign language learning. English, which continues to serve as the primary language of academic and professional communication worldwide, requires teachers at higher education institutions (HEIs) to continuously review and update their teaching methodologies. The relevance of this topic lies in the fact that AI technologies — including large language models, adaptive learning platforms, and automatic speech recognition systems — offer significant opportunities to personalise the learning process to meet the needs of individual students, reduce teachers' routine workload, and enhance learners' motivation. The aim of this study is to provide a theoretical analysis of the pedagogical potential of AI tools in the context of English language teaching at higher education institutions, to systematize their advantages and potential risks, and to develop a theoretical model for integrating these technologies into educational practice. title: Typology of cognitive distortions in military personnel during international exercises
text_snippet: Typology of cognitive distortions in military personnel during international exercises Background. In the context of Russia's full-scale armed aggression against Ukraine, the Armed Forces of Ukraine are actively engaged in joint training programs with partner nations' units. Interaction in a multinational environment, alongside its undeniable operational advantages, creates a specific psychological context in which cultural differences, language barriers, and the need to meet allied standards generate conditions for the emergence and entrenchment of cognitive distortions that negatively affect the performance effectiveness of military personnel and their psychological well-being. The scholarly literature contains substantial research on cognitive distortions in the general psychological context, as well as studies in the fields of military psychology and cross-cultural communication; however, a comprehensive analysis of cognitive distortions specifically in the context of international exercises remains lacking. Accordingly, the purpose of this article is to provide a theoretical analysis and typology of cognitive distortions in military personnel during international exercises as an independent psychological phenomenon. title: Transformation of the personnel psychological support system in the Armed Forces of Ukraine: current challenges and future directions for modernization
text_snippet: Transformation of the personnel psychological support system in the Armed Forces of Ukraine: current challenges and future directions for modernization Background . The purpose of the article is to provide a comprehensive analysis of the transformation of the military psychology system in the Armed Forces of Ukraine under the conditions of the contemporary Russian–Ukrainian war, as well as to identify key problems of its modernization and to substantiate the psychophysiological foundations of ensuring the combat readiness of military personnel. Methods . The study employs methods of analysis and synthesis of scholarly literature, comparative analysis of international approaches to military psychological training, and a systems approach to assessing the current state of military psychology in Ukraine. Results . The article provides a comprehensive analysis of transformative processes in the military psychology system in the context of the ongoing Russian–Ukrainian war and increasing requirements for the psychophysiological readiness of personnel in the Armed Forces of Ukraine. title: Euphemization and the falsification of the past as interrelated mechanisms of historical memory control: George Orwell's novel 1984 in the context of the Russian-Ukrainian war
text_snippet: Euphemization and the falsification of the past as interrelated mechanisms of historical memory control: George Orwell's novel 1984 in the context of the Russian-Ukrainian war Background. The Russian-Ukrainian War, which has continued since 2014 and entered its full-scale phase on 24 February 2022, has been accompanied by information and cognitive influence aimed at justifying aggression, constructing an image of the enemy, distorting historical information, and restricting access to alternative accounts. In George Orwell's novel 1984, similar mechanisms are illustrated through the euphemistic naming of state activities, the systematic alteration of documents, and the coercive subordination of personal memory. The article aims to identify the forms and functions of these mechanisms in the novel and to compare them with Russia's information operations supporting its war against Ukraine. The study is based on the Ukrainian translation of 1984 by Olena Oksenych, published in 2023. Methods. title: The concept of intelligentized warfare in the PRC's military and political strategy: technological, information, and geopolitical dimensions
text_snippet: The concept of intelligentized warfare in the PRC's military and political strategy: technological, information, and geopolitical dimensions Background. The article examines the doctrinal and organizational transformation of the military-political strategy of the People's Republic of China in the context of global rivalry with the United States. It explores the evolution of the CCP leadership's approaches to utilizing the information sphere as an instrument of geopolitical influence and power projection. Methods. The study is based on a qualitative analysis of primary sources (PRC strategic documents, laws, and CCP reports) and secondary data from leading Western think tanks (RAND Corporation, GMF). The systems method was applied to examine the concept of intelligentization as an element of the PRC's security architecture; the structural-functional method was used to assess reforms in the PLA's command and control systems; and the comparative method was employed to identify differences between the stages of "mechanization," "informatization," and "intelligentization" of warfare. Results. Key priorities for the technological rearmament of the PLA, alongside the integration of artificial intelligence, big data systems, and quantum technologies into the military sphere, have been identified. text_snippet: METHODOLOGICAL ASPECTS OF INTENSIFYING LANGUAGE TRAINING FOR CADETS:ANALYSIS OF THE RESULTS OF THE FIRST STAGE OF THE LANGUAGE EXPERIMENT B a c k g r o u n d . text_snippet: ASSESSMENT OF THE SECURITY ARCHITECTURE: DEFINED OBJECTIVES AND ACHIEVED OUTCOMES AT THE REGIONAL LEVEL Background. title: THE USE OF UAV SENSORS FOR GEO-SPATIAL DATA COLLECTION IN MINE ACTION TASKS
text_snippet: THE USE OF UAV SENSORS FOR GEO-SPATIAL DATA COLLECTION IN MINE ACTION TASKS Background. Mine contamination of territories poses a threat to public safety and sustainable development. Traditional demining methods remain dangerous, resource-intensive, and slow, which necessitates the implementation of innovative technologies. One of the promising directions is the use of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) as platforms for collecting geospatial data using various types of sensors. The aim of the study is to analyse the possibilities of using UAV sensors in mine action activities and to assess their potential for increasing the effectiveness of mine and explosive ordnance detection. Methods. The study is based on the theoretical analysis of contemporary scientific publications, regulatory documents, and technical solutions in the field of mine action. Methods of systematisation and generalisation were applied to classify sensors according to their operating principle, functional purpose, and possibilities of use on UAV platforms. A comparative analysis of their advantages, limitations, and application areas was conducted. title: AN IMPROVED APPROACH TO THE DISTRIBUTION OF GEOSPATIAL SUPPORT FORCESFOR TASK EXECUTION IN AN OPERATION
text_snippet: AN IMPROVED APPROACH TO THE DISTRIBUTION OF GEOSPATIAL SUPPORT FORCESFOR TASK EXECUTION IN AN OPERATION Background. The need to improve and further develop geospatial support as a component of operational support is determined by modern requirements for information about terrain and objects located on it, which is necessary for military command and control bodies and troops (forces) due to the implementation of automated command and weapon control systems, the need for rapid response to changes in the operational environment, the high dynamics of modern combat operations, and the development of precision-guided weapons. Taking into account the experience of the Russia’s war against Ukraine and the rapid development of information technologies, the requirements for geospatial support are changing. Its characteristic features today include: the use of geospatial technologies for terrain analysis and decision-making tasks; the introduction into the armed forces of new types of terrain-related products, such as digital orthophoto maps, orthophoto images, spatial terrain models, visibility maps, and others; and ensuring the rapid dissemination of geospatial information to authorized users through automated command and control systems. title: SUPPORT SERVICES OFFICER AS A SUBJECT OF EARLY IDENTIFICATIONOF SOCIAL RISKS IN A MILITARY UNIT
text_snippet: SUPPORT SERVICES OFFICER AS A SUBJECT OF EARLY IDENTIFICATIONOF SOCIAL RISKS IN A MILITARY UNIT Background. Social stability within a military unit is a key factor in ensuring a favourable moral and psychological climate, combat readiness, and the effective performance of assigned tasks. A support services officer acts as a central figure in the system of early identification of social risks, capable of detecting potential problems at the level of interpersonal interaction, group dynamics, and the organizational culture of the unit even before the emergence of open conflicts or social tension within military groups. Methods. The study employed a set of methods, including: systemic analysis of social processes in military groups; content analysis of regulatory and legal acts and guiding documents of the Armed Forces of Ukraine; analysis of preventive social intervention practices carried out by support services officers; integrative analysis of interaction with command staff, psychological services, and medical units; and elements of a case study analysis concerning the identification of social risks in specific units. title: PSYCHOLOGICAL READINESS OF FUTURE BORDER GUARD OFFICERS FOR COMMAND DECISION-MAKING IN EXTREME CONDITIONS OF OPERATIONAL AND SERVICE ACTIVITIES: A STRUCTURAL-COMPONENT ANALYSIS
text_snippet: PSYCHOLOGICAL READINESS OF FUTURE BORDER GUARD OFFICERS FOR COMMAND DECISION-MAKING IN EXTREME CONDITIONS OF OPERATIONAL AND SERVICE ACTIVITIES: A STRUCTURAL-COMPONENT ANALYSIS Background. The full-scale invasion by the Russian Federation and the transformation of the security environment have significantly increased the requirements for the psychological readiness of officers of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine (SBGSU) to make command decisions in extreme conditions of operational and service activities. The phenomenon of command decision-making by a border guard officer is multicontextual: according to the Law of Ukraine “On the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine” (2003), five functionally distinct types of command decisions are identified, each imposing specific psychological requirements. The aim of the study is to conduct a theoretical analysis of the phenomenon of psychological readiness of future border guard officers for command decision-making and to develop an original structural-component model of this psychological construct. title: IDENTIFICATION AND ASSESSMENT OF CANDIDATES' APTITUDE FOR SCIENTIFIC ACTIVITY DURINGTHE SELECTION PROCESS FOR ADJUNCTIVE PROGRAMMES
text_snippet: IDENTIFICATION AND ASSESSMENT OF CANDIDATES' APTITUDE FOR SCIENTIFIC ACTIVITY DURINGTHE SELECTION PROCESS FOR ADJUNCTIVE PROGRAMMES Background. The effectiveness of the functioning of Higher Military Educational Institutions (HMEIs), Military Educational Units of Higher Education Institutions, and Research Institutions within the system of the Ministry of Defence of Ukraine largely depends on the quality of training of scientific and scientific-pedagogical personnel, which is carried out primarily through adjuncture programmes at military higher educational institutions and research institutions. A key factor in this context is the selection of candidates for adjuncture studies. However, an analysis of the functioning of adjuncture programmes reveals a persistent negative trend, namely the discrepancy between the number of successful graduates and enrolment targets. A significant percentage of student dismissals during the course of study indicates the imperfection of the traditional administrative and qualification-based selection model, which does not take into account an officer's individual aptitude for specific scientific and research activities. title: COMMUNICATIVE ASPECTS OF PREPARING FUTURE OFFICERS FOR PROFESSIONAL INTERACTIONIN CRISIS CONDITIONS THROUGH SIMULATION MODELLING
text_snippet: COMMUNICATIVE ASPECTS OF PREPARING FUTURE OFFICERS FOR PROFESSIONAL INTERACTIONIN CRISIS CONDITIONS THROUGH SIMULATION MODELLING Background. Contemporary security challenges and the dynamic nature of the service and combat activities of units within the security and defence sector of Ukraine necessitate the improvement of the professional training of future officers, particularly regarding their readiness for effective professional interaction in crisis conditions. In such situations, communication serves as an important mechanism for coordinating unit actions, ensuring operational information exchange, and making managerial decisions. In this context, the use of simulation modelling tools becomes particularly relevant, as they make it possible to create training situations that are as close as possible to real service conditions. Methods. The study employed a combination of theoretical and empirical methods. title: TRANSFORMATION OF RUSSIA'S STRATEGIC INFORMATION OPERATIONS AGAINST UKRAINE (2024–2025):THE TECHNOLOGICAL DIMENSION AND PROACTIVE RESPONSE MECHANISMS
text_snippet: TRANSFORMATION OF RUSSIA'S STRATEGIC INFORMATION OPERATIONS AGAINST UKRAINE (2024–2025):THE TECHNOLOGICAL DIMENSION AND PROACTIVE RESPONSE MECHANISMS Background. Modern information and psychological operations (PSYOP) of Russia have finally transformed from an auxiliary tool into a system-forming element of the art of war integrated into strategic planning. The study fills a critical scientific gap regarding the underestimation of the technological factor of generative artificial intelligence (AI) as a tool of “digital occupation”, which during 2024–2025 became the basis for Moscow's transition to the model of “industrialized disinformation production”. Within the architecture of the Kremlin's hybrid aggression, the information and communication sphere has finally been legitimized as a full-fledged theatre of military operations. The strategic goal of the aggressor has shifted from quantitative indicators of audience coverage to qualitative markers of destruction, namely the artificial provocation of systemic vulnerabilities, paralysis of decision-making institutions, and the purposeful erosion of public consensus on national defence. text_snippet: MODERN APPROACHES TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF LEXICAL COMPETENCE:INTERACTIVE PLATFORMS AND CURRENT CHALLENGES Background. In contemporary conditions, there is growing interest in digital tools that can be used in foreign language teaching. The aim of this article is to generalize and analyze modern approaches and challenges faced by teachers in the process of developing learners' lexical competence. The review is based on the analysis of the works of Ukrainian and foreign scholars who have studied this field. The article examines the theoretical and practical aspects of modern approaches to the development of lexical competence within the framework of English for Specific Purposes (ESP) and foreign language learning in general, with particular emphasis on the use of interactive digital platforms. In the context of the theoretical foundations of professional lexical competence development and the definition of professional vocabulary, the role of fixed expressions, formulaic sequences, and technical neologisms in modern English is considered. text_snippet: PROFESSIONAL SELECTION SYSTEM AND PSYCHOMETRIC SUPPORT FOR UAV OPERATOR TRAINING: INTERNATIONAL EXPERIENCE Background. The contemporary paradigm of warfare is characterized by the dominance of robotic systems, where the efficacy of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) deployment critically depends on the cognitive resources of the human operator. The physical distancing of the remote pilot from the controlled platform transforms the requirements for their professional profile: traditional vestibular stability is superseded by high information processing speed, spatial reasoning, and the capacity for decision-making under severe time constraints. This article aims to conduct a comparative analysis of professional selection models and psychometric instrumentation for Remotely Piloted Aircraft (RPA) operators within the armed forces of leading nations (the United States of America, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, the Federal Republic of Germany, and the State of Israel). The objective is to identify key criteria and relevant cognitive assessment methodologies that can be integrated into the training systems of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. Methods. text_snippet: PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCE OF FUTURE PERSONNEL OFFICERS AS A CONCEPTUAL CATEGORY Background. The relevance of the study is determined by the fact that, under wartime conditions, personnel, mobilization, and organizational-staffing decisions have acquired particular importance, which has consequently increased the requirements for the training of officers directly involved in these processes. text_snippet: INTEGRATION OF WARGAMING INTO PROFESSIONAL MILITARY EDUCATION: A DIAGNOSTIC STUDY Background. The problem addressed is the lack of scientific substantiation for the integration of wargaming into the PME system. The aim of the study is to justify the role of wargaming as a component of digital transformation and to develop a three-level integration framework. Methods. text_snippet: SECONDARY TRAUMATIZATION OF COMBATANTS' WIVES AS AN INTEGRAL INDICATOR OF THE PSYCHOTRAUMATIC IMPACT OF WAR Background. Since military servicemen-combatants perform assigned tasks in various conditions, mostly life-threatening, obtaining relevant data about their actual psychological condition is a difficult task. It should be taken into account that a high level of danger and the impact of combat stress naturally suppress self-reflection and contribute to avoidance as a psychological defence mechanism under distress conditions. The psychological condition of combatants' wives indirectly reflects the level of the psychotraumatic impact of war both on themselves personally and on their partners. The study of the psychosocial profile of combatants' families makes it possible to analyze the psychological condition of respondents and their partners, family relationships, and socio-psychological issues, which will subsequently allow the development of interventions aimed at improving the well-being of military personnel's families. text_snippet: THE PROBLEM OF FOSSILIZED ERRORS AND THEIR CORRECTING DURINGA FOUR-MONTH INTENSIVE ENGLISH LANGUAGE COURSE (ALC – AMERICAN LANGUAGE COURSE) Background. Fossilized errors remain a persistent and widely discussed problem in the process of foreign language acquisition, particularly among learners attending intensive English language courses. Such errors tend to become fixed over time and resist correction even after repeated exposure to correct language forms. As a result, they hinder the development of communicative competence and negatively affect further language development, especially at intermediate and advanced levels. The problem becomes more complicated under conditions of intensive instruction, where a large volume of learning material and limited time for reflection may contribute to the reinforcement of incorrect language forms. Despite the considerable amount of theoretical research devoted to the phenomenon of fossilization, there remains a need for practice-oriented approaches aimed at effective error correction in real educational settings. The aim of the study is to identify effective methods and techniques for correcting fossilized and semi-fossilized errors under conditions of intensive foreign language learning instruction. Methods. text_snippet: Organization of social service provision for war veterans and their family members in the conditions of modern realities Background. The transformation of state social policy is analyzed with a focus on creating conditions for personal development. The ecosystem of adaptation for war veterans in the context of a prolonged conflict is examined. The essence of occupational therapy for the restoration of functions and social activity is revealed. The functional role of the veteran assistant institute (case management) and the role of the peer-to-peer principle for post-traumatic growth are described. text_snippet: Evolution of the social protection system for servicemen of the Armed Forces of Ukraine:a chronological analysis and contemporary challenges Background. The article examines the legal regulation of social protection of servicemen of the Armed Forces of Ukraine from the time of Ukraine's independence to the current conditions of full-scale war. The relevance of the study is driven by the need to adapt the existing legal and regulatory framework to new social challenges, particularly the need for fair and effective provision for military personnel and their families during the ongoing russian-Ukrainian war. Methods. The study employs legal and regulatory analysis to examine current legislation, comparative analysis to identify regulatory cycles, and document analysis of official decisions, resolutions, and legislative proposals related to the social protection of servicemen. Results. The article presents the legal regulation mechanism of social protection for servicemen as a cyclical process comprising five key stages: problem initiation, legislative development, adoption, implementation, and monitoring. title: Signs of cognitive deficit in military personnel with brain injury
text_snippet: Signs of cognitive deficit in military personnel with brain injury Background. Since the beginning of the full-scale invasion of the russian federation into the territory of Ukraine, there has been an extensive use of high-explosive weapons that exert strong impact on the human body. Both military personnel performing assigned tasks and civilians located far from the contact line are exposed to such weapons. One of the consequences of exposure to such powerful weapons is traumatic brain injury of varying severity. Such injury contributes to the emergence of disorders of the emotional-volitional, cognitive and behavioral domains. In the medical scientific literature, there is a sufficient number of publications devoted to the diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation of patients with traumatic brain injuries. However, in the psychological scientific literature, there is a certain shortage of such scientific research. Of particular relevance are studies related to the features of the manifestation of the consequences of traumatic brain injury in servicemen who received it while executing combat mission. text_snippet: Peculiarities of the interaction of veterans – combat participants and psychologists Background. Full-scale hostilities in Ukraine have led to a significant increase in the number of veterans requiring professional psychological assistance. At the same time, the effectiveness of psychological support largely depends on the quality of interaction between specialist and the veteran, taking into account combat experience, personal characteristics, level of trust and motivation for therapy. The relevance of the study is due to the need to identify barriers and resources in the process of psychological interaction with veterans who participated in combat operations. The aim of the article is to analyze the specific features of interaction between veterans and psychologists and to determine ways to enhance the effectiveness of psychological support. Methods.
